name: Bear Island
description: An island in the Sea of Marmara in the Thebes Tribunal, home to a sleeping titaness, faeries, vis sites and regiones; a possible covenant site.

name: Jasonian Way
description: A permanent path leading from the Temenos of Dindyméné to the Faerie regio through the faerie forest.

name: Temenos of Dindyméné
description: A sacred grove atop Mount Dindymon ringed by oaks and chestnuts, with a Magic aura of 3, leading to both a Faerie and a Magic regio.

name: Faerie Regio of Dindyméné
description: A Faerie regio (aura 6) above the temenos on Mount Dindymon, home to the ten Idaian Daktyls in stone and log huts.

name: Magic Regio of Dindyméné
description: An uninhabited Magic regio (aura 6) that is an enlarged copy of the temenos, producing Herbam and Terram vis annually and granting Calm +2 to visitors.

name: Mount Dindymon
description: The mountain on Bear Island atop which the Temenos of Dindyméné lies and beneath which the titaness Dindyméné is bound.

name: Artakia
description: The Greek town on Bear Island whose citizens know of the faerie regio and whose spring has a Magic aura of 2.

name: Spring of Artakia
description: A spring near Artakia with a Magic aura of 2, the easiest site on Bear Island at which to found a covenant.

name: Chytus Harbor
description: The harbor on Bear Island watched by the Gegenees, whose external vis lies in boulders scattered around it.

name: Bear Mountain
description: The forested hills of Bear Island where the Gegenees live.

name: Sea of Marmara
description: A busy sea near the western end of the Silk Road where Bear Island lies and where the halcyon's vis source is hidden in coves.

name: Holy Land
description: Region just south of the Sea of Marmara's traffic routes, mentioned as a destination for vessels.

name: Silk Road
description: Trade route whose western end lies near the Sea of Marmara.

name: Alexandria
description: The covenant of the Theban Redcaps, where journals and records including directions to Bear Island are kept.

name: Hypereia
description: An island of the Thebes Tribunal inhabited by cyclopes.

name: Italy
description: Land off whose coast Scylla lives in a large rock.

name: Phrygia
description: Region where Dindyméné is called Kybélé.

name: Anatolia
description: Region where Dindyméné is called Kubaba; also a suggested location for the Cursewood in the Theban variant.

name: Greece
description: Mainland where Dindyméné is known as Rhea.

name: Island of the Sleeping Fomóir
description: Variant renaming of Bear Island when moved to the Hibernia Tribunal.

name: Cursewood
description: A cursed forest in a barren valley in Pomerania, about 30 miles across, home of the daimon Wyzwanie and site of Regulus' sanctum, covered by a Malevolent Infernal aura of 5.

name: Pomerania
description: Sparsely settled forested region in the eastern marches of the Rhine Tribunal, bordering Novgorod, where the Cursewood lies.

name: Novgorod
description: Region bordering Pomerania.

name: Baltic Coast
description: Coast along which Pomerania's major settlements lie, distant from the Cursewood.

name: Empire of Nicea
description: Possible location for the Cursewood in the Theban Tribunal variant.

name: Ulster
description: Region in the Hibernian variant, between Lough Neagh and the northern coast, where the Cursewood could be set.

name: Lough Neagh
description: Lake in Ulster used as a reference point for the Hibernian variant of the Cursewood.

name: Vannes
description: Town used as a reference point for placing the Cursewood in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: St. Brieve
description: Town used as a reference point for placing the Cursewood in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Regulus' Encampment
description: Regulus' sanctum and camp at the center of the Cursewood, now pulled into a level 7 Magic regio with a cottage, lake and the Old Oak.

name: The Old Oak
description: An ancient twisted oak with blood-colored leaves and a pained face in its bark where Regulus was hanged; the source of the Cursewood's Infernal aura and of poisoned Perdo vis sordida.

name: The Poisoned Sap
description: Vis site: the Old Oak oozes poisonous sap yielding Perdo vis sordida.

name: Apples of Indigo Hue
description: Vis site: a single apple tree in an old orchard bearing blue apples with up to 4 pawns of Herbam vis sordida yearly.

name: Crystal Geodes
description: Vis site: a cave under the highest hill where crystals grow, giving up to 4 pawns of Terram vis sordida yearly.

name: The Silver Fish
description: Vis site: a pool at the lake's edge whose fish yield up to 4 pawns of Aquam vis sordida yearly.

name: The Lightning Tree
description: Vis site: lightning-struck trees on a hilltop with glowing branches holding up to 4 pawns of Auram vis sordida yearly.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Bear Island, where each covenant must bind a patron spirit.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose libraries hold copies of the Argonautika.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Western tribunal where Valerius Flaccus' Argonautika is easier to find.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Western tribunal where Valerius Flaccus' Argonautika is easier to find.

name: Hibernia Tribunal
description: Tribunal to which Bear Island and the Cursewood may be moved as variants; its covenants need a cathach.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal nominally containing the Cursewood in Pomerania; sigils of dead magi pass to a Master or Archmagus.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal offered as a variant location for the Cursewood.

name: Dindyméné
description: A titaness and kosmokrator Daimon of the Magic Realm, mother of Zeus, imprisoned asleep beneath Mount Dindymon; embodies fertility, mountains and wild beasts, with Magic Might 75.

name: Zeus
description: Son of Dindyméné who with his siblings imprisoned her beneath Mount Dindymon.

name: Uranus
description: Primordial sky god, father of Dindyméné.

name: Gaia
description: Primordial earth goddess, mother of Dindyméné.

name: Argos
description: Legendary craftsman who built Jason's ship and carved the Xoanon of Dindyméné.

name: Jason
description: Mythic hero whose voyage visited Bear Island and who propitiated Dindyméné.

name: Kyzikos
description: Legendary king whose slaying is mentioned in the Golden Fleece legend; his staters are said to be buried on Bear Island.

name: Aeneas
description: Legendary figure whose travels are more popular than the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Apollonios Rhodios
description: Author of the poem Argonautika.

name: Apollodorus
description: Author of the Library, which summarizes the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Hyginus
description: Author of the Fabulae, which summarizes the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Valerius Flaccus
description: Plagiarist author of a dull but accurate Latin Argonautika.

name: Pliny
description: Ancient author who commented on the halcyon's benevolent behavior.

name: Aristotle
description: Ancient author who commented on the halcyon's benevolent behavior.

name: Poseidon
description: God whose holy symbols (trident, horses, sea shells) ward against the Gegenees.

name: Titias
description: A male Idaian Daktyl who remains on Bear Island and seeks the magi's help.

name: Kyllénos
description: A female Idaian Daktyl who remains on Bear Island with Titias.

name: Conaing
description: A Fomóir leader magically put to sleep by Lugh; the Hibernian replacement for Dindyméné.

name: Lugh
description: Famous Irish hero who put Conaing to sleep.

name: St. Brendan
description: Saint whose baptismal font replaces the xoanon in the Hibernian variant.

name: Regulus ex Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus who about a century ago investigated the Cursewood, built his sanctum there, and was slain by Terentia's diabolists.

name: Wyzwanie
description: A powerful daimon and genius loci embodying the Cursewood's hostile forest, who tests intruders and guards the infernal artifact; Magic Might 40 (Herbam).

name: Terentia
description: A powerful demon of rage and war whose diabolist followers slew Regulus with an infernal artifact.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder of House Tytalus whose mysterious disappearance resembles Regulus' fate.

name: Mara ex Miscellanea
description: A young maga of Ex Miscellanea, Regulus' amica and proxy holder of his sigil, author of Curses and Corruption.

name: Stanica
description: Filia of Mara ex Miscellanea who inherited Regulus' proxy vote.

name: Alexandros of Bonisagus
description: Author of the summa On Airy Spirits of Significant Places.

name: Constantine Alexander of Jerbiton
description: Author of the Terram summa A Material Inspired by the Divine.

name: Vries van Breinermoor of Tremere
description: Author of the Vim summa The Arcane Tool.

name: Pholus of Tytalus
description: Author of the Magic Lore tractatus Commanding Spirits.

name: Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea
description: Author of the Vim tractatus Unravel That Which is Cast.

name: Kraxios Lord of Wrath
description: A demon who could draw the remaining Infernal aura into a hidden regio and cause paranoid dreams among grogs.

name: Schwarzholz
description: A dark faerie prince who, in a variant, takes over the Cursewood and mimics the Infernal taint to torment Wyzwanie.

name: Franz
description: A monk who investigated the Cursewood, was scared off, and hid a copy of De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos.

name: Michael Psellos
description: Author of De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House of crafters likely interested in the Daktyls' metalworking lore.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Regulus; also cited for leper healers interested in the Daktyls.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic researchers who would enjoy meeting the Daktyls.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House whose trophy-hunters would hang Gegenees heads.

name: House Mercere
description: House whose official records list Regulus' message address; its Theban Redcaps hold information on Bear Island.

name: House Guernicus
description: House that recorded Regulus entering the Order after his Gauntlet.

name: House Merinita
description: House whose magi would value a faerie forest.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House of Constantine Alexander.

name: House Tremere
description: House of Vries van Breinermoor.

name: Ex Miscellanea
description: House of Mara and Dairmuid.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order whose members' knowledge of Regulus is rolled via Organization Lore.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators who check proxy votes and want to know if Regulus lives.

name: Theban Redcaps
description: Redcaps of the Thebes Tribunal, the likeliest source of information on Bear Island.

name: Cult of Wyzwanie
description: A Mystery Cult Regulus was building around communing with Wyzwanie using Walking the Path.

name: Tuatha Dé Danann
description: Powerful faeries replacing the Idaian Daktyls in the Hibernian variant, enslaved by Conaing.

name: Fomóir
description: Mythic Irish race whose leader Conaing sleeps on the variant island.

name: Idaian Daktyls
description: Ten faeries (five male smiths, five female healers) who act as intercessors between Dindyméné and her worshipers and guard her xoanon; Faerie Might 30.

name: Gegenes
description: A six-armed faerie giant living on Bear Island's forested slopes that attacks intruders at Chytus Harbor; Faerie Might 20 (Terram).

name: Halcyon
description: A mythical magic sea bird serving Dindyméné that calms winds around the winter solstice and eats the Magic regio's Herbam vis; Magic Might 15 (Auram).

name: Scylla
description: A horrendous monster living in a rock off Italy.

name: Cyclopes
description: Monsters inhabiting the island of Hypereia.

name: Sea nymphs
description: Nymphs that sun themselves on island beaches in the Thebes Tribunal.

name: Fathach
description: An ugly saw-toothed two-armed giant replacing the Gegenes in the Hibernian variant.

name: Corrupted Tree
description: Oaks, willows and pines of the Cursewood awakened and corrupted by the Infernal aura that ambush and devour victims; Infernal Might 10.

name: Aspect
description: A physical representation a Daimon sends into the material world; it can be dismissed and replaced at will.

name: Xoanon of Dindyméné
description: A wooden effigy carved by Argos with Magic powers to create a bear or lion, command beasts, and summon a storm; required to wake or sleep Dindyméné.

name: Baptismal font of St. Brendan
description: Hibernian variant replacement for the xoanon, with the same powers; an ideal cathach.

name: Infernal artifact of Terentia
description: A demonic artifact of Terentia used against Regulus and now enclosed in Wyzwanie's boulder aspect.

name: Regulus' Tablet of Power
description: Regulus' talisman, a cypress and cedar tablet set with a star ruby, holding Master of the Magic Spirit and Binding the Magic Spirit.

name: Regulus' Staff of Unraveling
description: An elm staff with basalt and a magnet that cancels Aquam, Auram, Herbam and Terram effects.

name: Kyzikos staters
description: Lost coins said to be buried in chests on Bear Island.

name: Argonautika
description: Poem of the Golden Fleece by Apollonios Rhodios (and a Latin version by Valerius Flaccus); tractati of Faerie Lore Quality 6.

name: Library of Apollodorus
description: A work summarizing the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Fabulae
description: Hyginus' work summarizing the Golden Fleece legend.

name: Besting the Challenge
description: Summa on Area Lore: Cursewood by Regulus, Level 3 Quality 9.

name: On Airy Spirits of Significant Places
description: Summa on Magic Lore by Alexandros of Bonisagus, Quality 12 Level 3.

name: A Material Inspired by the Divine
description: Summa on Terram by Constantine Alexander of Jerbiton, Quality 13 Level 7.

name: The Arcane Tool
description: Summa on Vim by Vries van Breinermoor of Tremere, Quality 9 Level 6.

name: Journal of Regulus
description: Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 9, revealing Wyzwanie, the diabolists, vis sources and Significatos.

name: Commanding Spirits
description: Tractatus on Magic Lore by Pholus of Tytalus, Quality 9.

name: Unravel That Which is Cast
description: Tractatus on Vim by Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea, Quality 10.

name: Curses and Corruption
description: Mara's Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 8.

name: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos
description: Book by Michael Psellos; a Latin copy is a Summa on Infernal Lore Level 5 Quality 10.

name: Cathach
description: A trophy item Hibernian covenants need.

name: Pierce the Faerie Veil
description: Spell that detects the Faerie regio.

name: Pierce the Magic Veil
description: Variant spell highlighting the Magic regio.

name: Clouds of Rain and Thunder
description: Hermetic spell equivalent to the xoanon's storm power.

name: Crest of the Earth Wave
description: Hermetic spell echoed by a Dindyméné power.

name: Teeth of the Earth Mother
description: Hermetic spell echoed by a Dindyméné signature power.

name: The Earth Split Asunder
description: Hermetic spell echoed by a Dindyméné power.

name: The Incantation of Lightning
description: Hermetic spell echoed by a Dindyméné power.

name: The Leap of Homecoming
description: Spell to which the halcyon's Impossible Retreat is similar.

name: Intuition of the Forest
description: Spell that fails in the Cursewood because Wyzwanie will not speak.

name: Wall of Thorns
description: Spell whose effect a Cursewood thorn hazard duplicates.

name: Talons of the Wind
description: Spell used as an example of hostile weather.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: Spell used as an example of hostile weather.

name: The Earth's Carbuncle
description: Spell used as an example of exploding ground.

name: Hands of the Grasping Earth
description: Spell similar to the sucking quicksand hazard.

name: Crystal Dart
description: Spell that can harm corrupted trees.

name: Piercing Shaft of Wood
description: Spell that cannot hurt corrupted trees.

name: Master of the Magic Spirit
description: ReVi 41 effect in Regulus' Tablet forcing an Airy Spirit to obey.

name: Binding the Magic Spirit
description: ReVi 51 effect in Regulus' Tablet binding a Magic being in a circle.

name: Unravelling the Fabric of Aquam
description: PeVi 40 effect in Regulus' Staff cancelling Aquam effects; similar effects exist for Auram, Herbam and Terram.

name: Breath of the Angry Goddess
description: Dindyméné's power creating winds that trap ships at Bear Island.

name: Foul Weather made Fair
description: Dindyméné's power cancelling Breath of the Angry Goddess or stopping storms.

name: Heed the Mistress' Command
description: Dindyméné's power forcing an animal to obey her for a day.

name: The Animal's Tongue
description: Dindyméné's ritual power granting the Animal Ken Virtue.

name: The Goddess's Companion
description: Dindyméné's ritual power creating a mundane bear.

name: The Goddess's Protector
description: Dindyméné's ritual power creating a mundane lion.

name: The Wrath of the Earth Mother
description: Dindyméné's power causing a severe earthquake.

name: Enter the Faerie Forest
description: Gegenes power to pass between the faerie forest regio and mundane forest on Bear Island.

name: Haleyon's Idyllic Day
description: Halcyon power calming storms over water.

name: The Impossible Retreat
description: Halcyon power to teleport to an Arcane Connection.

name: Enter the Sylvan Glen
description: Daktyl power to enter any Faerie regio.

name: Smithying
description: Male Daktyl power duplicating CrTe/MuTe/ReTe spells.

name: Physicianing
description: Female Daktyl power duplicating CrCo/MuCo/ReCo spells.

name: Hibernation
description: Wyzwanie's power to go dormant for a year and build Might Pool.

name: Grant Deficiency
description: Wyzwanie's power halving a target's Ability or Form until sunrise or sunset.

name: Ruler of Nature
description: Wyzwanie's power duplicating natural weather, water, plant and earth spells.

name: Animated Branches
description: Corrupted tree power to wield branches as weapons.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural ability that reveals regio boundaries.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Ability to find regio entrances.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: Supernatural Virtue by which Dindyméné grants the Daktyls access to her Magic powers.

name: External Vis
description: Gegenes quality: its vis lies in an external rock.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Gegenes flaw.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Gegenes ward against Poseidon's holy symbols.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: Daktyl ward against Christian religious symbols.

name: Magical Master
description: Dindyméné's Virtue.

name: Wrathful
description: Dindyméné's flaw.

name: Magic Animal
description: Halcyon's virtue as a magical beast.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: The halcyon's vis source hidden on the Sea of Marmara's southern shore.

name: Unaffected by the Gift
description: Halcyon virtue.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Daktyl virtue.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Daktyl virtue.

name: Humanoid Faerie
description: Daktyl virtue.

name: Place of Power
description: Daktyl virtue tied to the Bear Island Faerie Regio.

name: Positive Folktales
description: Daktyl virtue.

name: Ways of the Forest
description: Virtue appropriate to Wyzwanie and his cult.

name: Elemental Magic
description: Virtue whose Herbam variant, Nature Wizard, suits the Cult of Wyzwanie.

name: Nature Wizard
description: A variant of Elemental Magic affecting Herbam rather than Ignem.

name: Magical Focus
description: A Herbam magus with a focus in wood bypasses Cursewood obstacles easily.

name: Daimon
description: Quality of Dindyméné and Wyzwanie as primal Magic spirits.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability used to perform the ceremony to wake Dindyméné.

name: Magic Lore
description: Lore Ability; several books in Regulus' library cover it.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability used to study vis sordida and demons.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Ability usable to research Terentia.

name: Forest Lore
description: Ability allowing communion with Wyzwanie.

name: Nature Lore
description: Lore Wyzwanie may teach.

name: Area Lore: Cursewood
description: Area Lore covered by several books in Regulus' library.

name: Area Lore: Pomerania
description: Ability rolled to know about Pomerania.

name: Organization Lore: Order of Hermes
description: Ability to know about Regulus.

name: Animal Ken
description: Ability and Virtue granted by Dindyméné.

name: Summon Animals
description: Dindyméné's Ability.

name: Leadership
description: Ability limiting group size in the Cursewood trek.

name: Survival
description: Ability for forest trekking.

name: Athletics
description: Ability for swamp wading and hill climbing.

name: Profession: Boating
description: Ability for swamp/river boat travel.

name: Swimming
description: Ability for swamp swimming.

name: Communication
description: Characteristic used in the waking ceremony.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability of Wyzwanie.

name: Penetration
description: Ability for overcoming Magic Resistance.

name: Creo
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Rego
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Muto
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Perdo
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Animal
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Herbam
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Terram
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Auram
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Aquam
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Corpus
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Vim
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Mentem
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Ignem
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Imaginem
description: One of the Hermetic Arts referenced in this text.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of which Dindyméné and Wyzwanie are resident spirits.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of the Daktyls' regio and the Gegenees.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of Terentia and the corrupting aura of the Cursewood.

name: Divine
description: Realm to which the talking dove belongs in the Hibernian variant.

name: Regio
description: A layered supernatural area such as those atop Mount Dindymon and at the Cursewood's center.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura rating (Magic, Faerie, Infernal) of a place.

name: Malevolent aura
description: A corrupted Infernal aura caused by cruelty and sin, as covers the Cursewood.

name: Vis
description: Magical raw power found in pawns at vis sites.

name: Vis sordida
description: Filthy vis formed in Infernal auras, carrying Wrathful and botch risks.

name: Significato
description: A naturally occurring magical phenomenon magi can study like vis.

name: Kosmokrator
description: One of the primal spirits of the Magic Realm; Dindyméné is one.

name: Genius loci
description: A spirit of place; a powerful subset of Airy Spirits.

name: Airy Spirits
description: Weak magical spirits of flora, fauna, elements or phenomena.

name: Titan
description: Primordial beings such as Dindyméné, imprisoned by Zeus.

name: Patron spirit
description: A spirit each Theban covenant must bind.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Esoteric Hermetic cult with initiation scripts.

name: Initiation Script
description: Script used by Mystery Cults to initiate members.

name: Walking the Path
description: Mechanic of Sacrifice, Quest and Fruit used for communing with Wyzwanie.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural ability of magi derived from the Magic realm.

name: Twilight
description: Hazard checked for on a double botch when extracting vis.

name: Gauntlet
description: Ceremony ending apprenticeship after which Regulus entered the Order.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Oath sworn by magi entering the Order.

name: Sigil
description: A magus' voting token that can be lent as a proxy at Tribunal.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a place used for teleportation.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that powers must Penetrate.

name: Magic Might
description: Might score of Magic beings.

name: Faerie Might
description: Might score of faeries.

name: Infernal Might
description: Might score of Infernal beings like corrupted trees.

name: Covenant Boons and Hooks
description: Preexisting boons and hooks for a covenant at the Magic temenos.

name: Regio Sight Roll
description: Roll to see a regio boundary.

name: Golden Fleece
description: Legend of Jason recounted in the Argonautika.

name: Trojan War
description: Legend more popular than the Golden Fleece.

name: Long Term Fatigue
description: Fatigue levels lost per stage of the Cursewood trek.

name: Deprivation
description: Rules for lack of air applied to quicksand and corrupted trees.

name: Diabolists
description: Terentia's followers who slew Regulus.

name: Covenant
description: A community of magi; Bear Island and the Cursewood are potential sites.

name: Sanctum
description: A magus' private domain, marked by a sanctum marker.

name: Talisman
description: A magus' personal enchanted item, like Regulus' Tablet of Power.

name: Ink of Hermes
description: Magical ink inscribed on Regulus' tablet and staff.
